source.contract: Selected display name is a min-width-zero truncate span in the trigger; query is separate popup input. Native still retains existing editable combo, not full source popup parity.

observedDefect: Actual package selected label showed its tail because editable QLineEdit horizontally scrolls to its editing caret. MainWindow refreshModels blocks combo signals, so its existing currentIndexChanged cursor-reset hook cannot reliably anchor restored text. Actual host regression reproduces differing idle images at caret0/end.
fix: New ModelSelector uses ordinary QLineEdit when focused or displaying an unmatched/manual query.

Only an unfocused exact selected label paints left anchored with right ellipsis using native style/font/palette/content rect. Full underlying text, caret, model identity and selection persistence are untouched.
Full selected/query text remains tooltip via child textChanged even when combo signals are blocked; handler is terminal.
MainWindow change is include + replacing only the model combo construction. No header ABI, provider, composer send, SideChat or filtering contract changes.

final.notes: 9/9 new actual MainWindow cases plus5/5 focused navigation and4/4 focused UI-audit rows. Not full existing-suite runs.

fixtureCorrection.explanation: Initial new completion fixture sent keys to the edit while completion popup owned input; it failed identically on unmodified baseline and patched host. Revised fixture clicks the real completion popup viewport row after proving one case-insensitive substring match. No production completion behavior change was made.

peerReview.scope: Bounded source-only idle-paint/owner/callback review found no concrete issue. Focused/manual-query paint remains base QLineEdit; tooltip handler terminal; no independent runtime test or universal custom-style callback guarantee.

dependencies.scope: Uses the previously copied coherent154-suite root headers/libraries, replacing only MainWindow/ModelSelector object implementation. No mutable shared archive dependencies.

limits: Focused editable search may horizontally scroll normally to its caret; idle exact-selected display is the repaired contract.
Existing native combo still lacks source provider logo and separate query-popup layout; this narrow fix does not claim full model-selector parity.
Current geometry gates cover1100/350 widths,light/dark and long Latin fixture labels. Qt handles font/elision; no assertion of universal glyph/layout behavior.
Full shared rebuild, integration and packaged Windows confirmation remain parent-owned/pending.
